about: Which clockwise quarter turn makes each session photograph upright, after the phone's decode (EXIF applied). Where the classical tracer reads the sheet (grid fit, median lead PCC >= 0.3 against the best of the 12 printed records, and well above the half-turned candidate), that decides; otherwise the photograph was inspected (rectified page, left third: the 1 mV pulses stand at the left of each row, rising; the labels and '25mm/s' read upright). Made 2026-10-15 for run_orientation_sessions.py (progress_log §39).
